volume.title: The Hanged Man
volume.author: Cuttlefish That Loves Diving
volume.title_meaning: Its main meaning comes from the interpretation of the Tarot card, and Author endows it with two relatively obvious meanings: First, take the initiative to sacrifice yourself or pay the price; The second is that when you are in a dilemma, do not struggle in vain, but look at the problem from another angle, look at yourself calmly, think about the future, and wait patiently for something to happen. Since the seventh volume, the sacrifices have been made by Roselle, Mr.Door, the Ancient Sun God who decided to give up important things. Those who paid the price included Alger, Klein, True Creator and Adam.
volume.synopsis: Derrick has now become an Elder and led some of City of Silver's Beyonders through the door where they see a boat for the first time carrying Danitz. They settle down in the New City of Silver and New Moon City near the Bayam, and founded the Church of the Fool. Klein advanced to Sequence 2 Miracle Invoker. He entered the Spirit World to visit the Seven Lights and learned some truth of the Original Creator, the secrets of the Outer Deities, as well as the true identity of the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings. Klein return to Loen Kingdom and he got the magic mirror Arrodes from Bornova Gustav. He acting as the wandering magician to digest the potion under the identity of Merlin Hermes. Larrion, the chief shepherd of the Church of the God of Combat, escaped from the church with the Sealed Artifact 0-02. Arianna tracking after him to the Belltaine City. Under the Law of Convergence, Klein ended up enter the Belltaine City. He worked with Arianna to create rule loopholes and threw the 0-02 into the abandoned palace at the peak of the Hornacis Mountain Range. From there he got the Card of Blasphemy, The Fool. Bernadette explored the nameless island located on the Fog Sea. She entered Roselle's last mausoleum, learned about her father's corrupted, and sealed him using a symbol from Pale Death and help from the Mr. Fool. After Roselle forcibly sent Bernadette out of the mausoleum, Klein met him with his historical projection. He learned about Roselle's current state and the danger of the Cards of Blasphemy. Klein promise Roselle that he will save him from the corruption of the Mother Goddess of Depravity when he become the Great Old One. Klein built the marionette town Utopia as an essential part of his advancement ritual to promote to Sequence 1. His main body hid under the Saint Arianna Cathedral to control every marionettes. Meanwhile Zaratul sneak into the Utopia with the help of Adam. When Zaratul isolated him from the Sefirah Castle using historical projection of William Augustus, Klein ran into the old metropolis of the Pre-First Epoch inside the fog of history. However, he stabbed by the German Sparrow who had been given humanity by Adam and fell into Adam's Corpse Cathedral. In his conversation with Adam, Klein learned about Adam's true identity and the specialness to the Visionary while waiting for his rescue by previous arrangements. He read the Second Blasphemy Slate. On the other side, Verdu Garcia was tricked by Amon and Red Angel Evil Spirit to hold a ritual to let Mr. Door return to the real world. Mr. Door's return triggered his apotheosis ritual, Mother Goddess of Depravity also tried to breach the barrier and enter Earth. In order to stop this, he gave up his life to Amon, who became sequence 0 by stealing his apotheosis ritual and shut Mother Goddess of Depravity out of Earth using the First Blasphemy Slate. Klein successfully died in the Corpse Cathedral through a deal with Genie by distorted wish and completed the advancement ritual directly. He drank the potion and advanced to Sequence 1 Attendant of Mysteries. Klein locked onto Zaratul and visited him. Zaratul was betrayed by his own historical projection of Knowledge Emperor Roselle and Klein directly killed him using Law of Convergence then devoured his Beyonder Characteristic, eventually, Klein became the King of Angels.

timeline_of_major_events.event: Derrick leads City of Silver Beyonders out the grayish-blue door and meets Danitz. Klein promoted to Sequence 2 Miracle Invoker. Klein met Seven Lights and learns the details of the Outer Deities. Ikanser Bernard and Machinery Hivemind moves to Intis Republic. Klein asked Bornova Gustav to take away the Magic Mirror Arrodes.
Demoness Sect summon Katarina Pelle back to their headquarters. Amon met Evil Spirit Sauron-Einhorn-Medici.

Tarot Club 135th Meeting. Tarot Club analyze and reveal the true identity of the Earth Mother. Fors Wall digested the Traveler potion. The Harvest Church reopened, and the Sanguines joined the faith of Earth Mother.

Klein arrived at Belltaine City. Larrion ran away from the Church with the Sealed Artifact 0-02, Trunsoest Brass Book. He attempted to trap his chasers in Belltaine City. Klein threw the 0-02 into the abandoned palace at the peak of the Hornacis Mountain Range. And he got the Card of Blasphemy, The Fool.
Danitz, Derrick Berg and City of Silver team arrived in Bayam.

Fors complete advancement ritual with Devil's Oil Painting and promoted to the Secrets Sorcerer. Fors briefly got in contact with Mr. Door. Klein arrived at Constant City and assists the Red Gloves team in solving the astronomy incident.

Dorian Gray tells the truth about the blood curse of the Abraham Family. Verdu Garcia insisted on releasing Mr. Door. The remaining people of City of Silver and Moon City moved into Bayam. Bernadette Gustav found the nameless island. She reunited and sealed Roselle Gustav. Klein met Roselle. Bernadette successfully prevented the disaster and promoted to the Sage. Hilarion give Bernadette the information about the Great Old Ones, the Outer Deity and the Cosmos.
Emlyn White becomes High-ranking Deacon of the Church of the Earth Mother. Alger Wilson received the task of monitoring Verdu Garcia.

True Creator seal off the Forsaken Land of the Gods. Audrey Hall met Mr. President of the Psychology Alchemists. And she became a member of the Psychology Alchemists Council, Miss Pride. Hermes became a member of the Psychology Alchemists Council, Mr. Wrath.
Amon rang the bell for the Church of the Fool.

Audrey meets Ariehogg and tells him about Liveseyd, 'Mr. Wraith' starts battle with Ariehogg before getting his questions answered and leaving. Klein built the marionette town Utopia. Zaratul snuck into the Utopia with the help of Adam. Klein was stabbed by the German Sparrow who had been given humanity by Adam and fell into Adam's Corpse Cathedral. Klein learned about Adam's true identity and the specialness to the Visionary, then read the Second Blasphemy Slate. Mr. Door return to the real world. Verdu Garcia died. Mother Goddess of Depravity tried to breach the barrier and enter Earth. Mr. Door gave his life to Amon. Amon became sequence 0 and shut Mother Goddess of Depravity out of Earth using the First Blasphemy Slate. Klein successfully died in the Corpse Cathedral through a deal with Genie. Klein promoted to Sequence 1 Attendant of Mysteries. Klein directly killed Zaratul and devoured his Beyonder Characteristics. Klein became the King of Angels.
